claims.evidence: Layer D reason: Claim 26 states 'The androgen leg is DHEA → androstenedione → testosterone' with testosterone as an endpoint. Claim 27 states 'The aromatase leg is androstenedione → estrone → estradiol' but implies testosterone converts to estradiol. No known single enzyme converts testosterone directly to estradiol—testosterone must first convert to androstenedione before reaching estrogens via aromatase. These two pathway leg descriptions cannot both accurately represent the steroid biosynthesis network..
